claims.content: The Auctioneer schedules an auction event by using auction event profiles to schedule groups of product and publishes the planned event schedule for site visitors.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer schedules an auction event by using auction event profiles to schedule groups of product and publishes the planned event schedule for site visitors.

claims.content: The Auctioneer has searched for and selected a list of auction product.
The auction group has been created.
The Auctioneer selects the “Create New Auctions” option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Admin Main Menu Page and clicks its GO button.
The Auctioneer schedules new auctions using the Scheduling New Auctions section of the Create New Auctions Page.
The Auctioneer uses the CMS to update the auction schedule page.
The Auctioneer publishes the planned event schedule for site visitors/bidders on the Event Schedule Page, which is formatted similarly to an Outlook monthly calendar.

If the Auctioneer wants to create a new promotional event, she begins by accessing the Auction Event Profiles Page. She tabs or clicks into the “Create New Profile” field, enters a new profile name, and clicks on “Create.” She then fills in the 2nd column, which is always the upper range of the cost tier; the system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered by the Auctioneer until all fields are completed. Working horizontally and adjacent to each cost tier, the Auctioneer chooses a radio button for either “amount” or “% of cost.”
The auction group is scheduled; each item has its opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time set, and the opening time is system-generated (calculated).

The planned event schedule is published by the Auctioneer (Auctions Category Manager) on the Event Schedule Page, which shows site visitors/bidders the planned event schedule in a format similar to an Outlook monthly calendar, using the CMS as the data source.
The Event Schedule Page lists auction events with their closing times, noting that all times are Eastern Standard Time (USA).
Items that do not have an available image to display or are not in a valid, sellable inventory location are not eligible for scheduling.
